**Finding submitted: INSURANCE — missing (redline validated, ok:true).**

What I checked:
- Full outline and every section (sec-p0000, sec-p0001, sec-1.4, sec-5.4, sec-p0072) read end-to-end.
- Targeted searches: "insurance" (0 hits), "insure/insured/coverage/policy" (0 hits), "indemnif" (0 hits), "liability" (only the no-joint-venture paragraphs p0061–p0062).
- No definition of "Customer Data"/"Confidential Information" in the definition tool; the operative data-handling language sits in Section 8.1 ("Content, user information, data"), so I anchored the cyber trigger to that terminology.

Why the rule bites: HDI designs, hosts, operates and maintains the Site on its own server, builds order export/import files, and has access to Company Content and user information — a services/hosting vendor that processes our data with zero insurance is walk-away territory, so the fallback (E&O $1M / cyber $2M) is not met either.

The fix: one `insert_after` p0070 creating Section 10.9 (Insurance) in the General Provisions — CGL $1M/$2M, E&O $2M, cyber/privacy $5M where HDI processes our Confidential Information or user data, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request — with all six preferred elements mapped to that single operation and no neighbouring text disturbed. The comment flags the E&O $1M / cyber $2M fallback as a landing zone.
